close_reason: Pre-partition paragraph added explaining roles_successfully_vacated/roles_intended_to_vacate invariants and warning against collapsing passes
description: The handle_mailbox_set update section in mailbox.rs uses a two-pass approach (vacating patches first, then non-vacating). The motivation (atomic role swap in a single request) is correct and documented in a comment, but the comment appears only at the partition call (line 584). A contributor who encounters roles_actually_vacated or roles_claimed_this_request without reading the partition comment first will not understand why these sets exist or the invariant they enforce. A short paragraph before the partition that says 'We process role-vacating patches first so that a single request can atomically swap two roles (A vacates inbox, B claims inbox). See RFC 8621 §2.5.' would make the intent immediately clear.
title: mailbox.rs: two-pass update loop intent requires reading 60 lines of code to understand
